·10 October 2026

## Deportivo Madryn eye firmer footing against Chaco For Ever in Reducido push

Deportivo Madryn aim to tighten their grip on a Reducido spot when they host Chaco For Ever on Sunday, matchday 33 of Primera Nacional 2026, Zone A.

According to SuperDepor.com, kick-off is 15:00 at the Abel Sastre.

## OneFootball Videos [...] Maximiliano Macheroni will referee, assisted by Manuel Sánchez and Matías González. The match can be followed live via LPF Play on its website and mobile app.

Luis García’s side sit fourth on 53 points. They won away to leaders Ferro last time out, and are unbeaten in six at home with five wins and one draw. [...] The visitors are 10th with 37 points. They drew with Defensores de Belgrano in their last outing and have gone five away matches without a win. They are playing what could be one of their final chances to reach the Reducido.

After this, Deportivo Madryn have three regular-season fixtures left, away to bottom side Acassuso, then at home to San Telmo, before finishing at San Miguel, another team fighting to stay up.

Source:  SuperDepor.com
